messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Comparing item parameters recovery between classical factor analysis and IRT
parts:
See these links:

http://philchalmers.github.io/SimDesign/html/03-Parameter_recovery_simulation.html 
http://philchalmers.github.io/SimDesign/html/02-TypeI_and_Power_simulation.html  

To get p-values in mirt you'll have to divide the parameter estimates from coef(mod, printSE=TRUE) by their associated SE, and use the 2 * pnorm(p/SE, lower.tail=FALSE) approach to get the two-tailed large sample p-value. 

Phil
